consider_for: Organisations moving virtual machines between on-premises, VMware, Hyper-V and public cloud environments that also want continuous replication for disaster recovery, as HPE documents for Zerto
pricing_note: HPE lists Zerto Software for AWS - Migration on AWS Marketplace at $400 per virtual machine to be migrated on a 12-month contract, with no refunds but cancellation at any time. Customers with existing licences can request a BYOL private offer. Other platforms and the disaster recovery editions are quoted (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per VM migrated on a 12-month contract (AWS Marketplace)

consider_for: IT teams migrating Windows and Linux servers between physical, VMware, Hyper-V and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud platforms with near-zero downtime, as OpenText documents for OpenText Migrate, formerly Carbonite Migrate
pricing_note: No published price. OpenText's product page does not list a price, and the product is also listed on Microsoft Marketplace. OpenText notes that partners also deliver managed migration services (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Organisations moving physical, virtual and cloud servers, including in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, into Oracle, IBM, Nutanix, Google Cloud or Azure environments without agents, as RackWare documents for its RackWare Management Module
pricing_note: No published price. RackWare's Azure Marketplace listing for the RackWare Management Module invites buyers to request two free migration licences; further licences, disaster recovery and the SWIFT Kubernetes product are quoted (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Enterprises and service providers running large migration waves from physical, virtual or cloud sources to more than a dozen public cloud and on-premises targets, as RiverMeadow documents for its Workload Mobility Platform
pricing_note: RiverMeadow's AWS Marketplace listing prices a self-service migration entitlement at $150 per source workload moved to Amazon EC2 and a managed migration service offer at $400 per workload, both on 12-month contracts. consider_for: VMware Cloud Foundation customers moving virtual machines between data centres or into VMware-based clouds without re-platforming, as Broadcom documents for HCX, now named VMware Cloud Foundation Operations workload mobility

consider_for: Large Indian enterprises that already run core HR on a single suite and want payroll processed in the same system, since Darwinbox documents a unified platform spanning the employee lifecycle and India-specific payroll

The product pages describe deployment choices between a lighter payroll option, a self-run configuration and managed services, which is a further variable in any quote (checked Sep 2026)

Separate start-up and blue-collar plans both state that pricing is by contact. Only add-ons carry figures, stated in US dollars: Selfie Punch, Timesheet and the Fia assistant at USD 0.5 a month, Face Recognition at USD 1, and Recruitment at USD 75 a month per recruiter (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Not recorded for plans; add-ons stated per month, per user or per recruiter in US dollars

consider_for: Indian payroll teams that file statutory returns in volume, since greytHR documents ECR generation, ESI challans, state-specific professional tax rules, eTDS returns and Form 24Q with FVU validation on its payroll page

Growth is ₹4,495 a month on the same 50-employee allowance with ₹85 above, adding advanced attendance and shift management, overtime, permissions, geo-fencing and confirmation workflow. Premium is custom-quoted with all modules. Add-ons carry published rates: performance management ₹35 to ₹45 per user per month, timesheets ₹35, expense ₹35, GPS live tracking ₹140 and greytHR Recruit ₹2,500 per recruiter per month (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Monthly base price including 50 employees, plus a per-employee rate above 50 and separately priced add-ons

consider_for: Indian companies that want payroll to draw directly from attendance, leave and expense in the same system, because Keka documents pre-built auto-sync between its payroll and workforce modules

billing_terms: Per additional employee per month above a plan base figure that is not stated in the page source

consider_for: Indian teams that want payroll, attendance and leave running before any licence spend, because Kredily publishes a free tier with no stated employee ceiling and no card requirement

consider_for: Indian companies around fifty employees that want payroll, leave, attendance and compliance under one annually billed price, as Pocket HRMS publishes the bundled headcount and the per-additional-employee rate for both paid tiers

Professional is ₹4,495 per month billed annually for 50 employees with ₹90 for each additional employee, adding geo-fencing, a custom payslip designer, a confirmation module, employee transfer, asset management and exit. billing_terms: Monthly price billed annually including 50 employees, plus a per-additional-employee rate

consider_for: Indian enterprises with employees in several countries that want one payroll platform rather than country-by-country vendors, since Ramco documents statutory coverage across 150-plus countries including India, Singapore, Malaysia and the Gulf states

consider_for: Indian startups running payroll for under a hundred employees that want statutory payment and filing bundled with disbursement, as RazorpayX Payroll lists compliance calculation, payments and filings on all published tiers

consider_for: Small and mid-sized Indian businesses that want the whole rate card published before signing up, since Zoho states plan prices, the included headcount and the per-employee rate above it on its India pricing page

Premium is ₹4,000 per month, includes 50 employees, ₹100 or ₹80 each above, and adds leave and attendance (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per organisation per month, billed monthly or annually, with a per-additional-employee rate above the included headcount

Gupshup charges a standard fee of USD 0.001 per template message for outgoing text and USD 0.001 per session message for outgoing and incoming text. Media above 64 kilobytes carries no additional Gupshup fee. Voice for user-initiated and business-initiated calls is USD 0.0001 per second. WhatsApp's own fee is charged separately by message category, covering marketing, utility, authentication and international authentication, and is billed at actuals. Service conversations and inbound voice calls are free, as are conversations starting from click-to-WhatsApp Meta ads for the first 72 hours. Rates vary by country and region code (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per message, with no subscription on the self-serve plan and WhatsApp fees passed through at actuals

consider_for: Large enterprises that need one agent platform spanning WhatsApp, web chat and voice in many languages, and that have the procurement capacity to negotiate an unpublished contract
pricing_note: Jio Haptik publishes no pricing. The pricing URL resolves to the product page, and every commercial route on the site is a demo or contact request. The company states more than 500 enterprise customers and describes deployment across web, chat and voice with support for more than 100 languages, but attaches no figure, tier structure or billing unit to any of it (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Not recorded. No billing unit is published

consider_for: Support organisations that measure workload in resolved conversations rather than messages, and that need WhatsApp alongside web, mobile app, Telegram and Instagram in the same agent
pricing_note: Starter is USD 40 a month billed monthly, or USD 34 billed yearly, and includes one AI agent, one team member, 250 conversations a month described as roughly 10,000 messages, web, mobile app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram channels and three months of chat history, with additional conversations at USD 15 per thousand and extra agents or seats at USD 20 a month each. Professional is USD 200 a month and includes two AI agents, three team members, 2,000 conversations described as roughly 80,000 messages, Zendesk, Freshdesk and Google Analytics integrations, phone call AI, a year of chat history, auto-resolve and API access, with additional conversations at USD 10 per thousand. Enterprise is quoted (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per month or per year against a conversation allowance, with published per-thousand overage and per-seat add-on rates

consider_for: Marketing and lifecycle teams that need the twelve-month cost of a WhatsApp flow modelled in advance, because Landbot publishes the base price, the included chat volume, the AI-chat allowance and the overage rate for every tier
pricing_note: Free is EUR 0 forever with one seat, 100 chats a month, no AI chats and a shared WhatsApp test number. Starter is EUR 40 a month or EUR 32 billed annually, with two seats, 500 chats and 100 AI chats. Professional is EUR 100 a month or EUR 80 billed annually, with three seats, 2,500 chats, 300 AI chats, no Landbot branding and the use of your own WhatsApp number. Business is quoted by contract. Extra chats are EUR 0.05 and extra AI chats EUR 0.10 (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per month, billed monthly or annually, against an included chat allowance with published per-chat overage

consider_for: Sales teams running WhatsApp as a primary selling channel, where the number of representatives is the natural unit and conversation volume per representative is high
pricing_note: Start is USD 30 per user per month with a minimum of five team members and covers the core team inbox, the chatbot builder, API and webhooks, and Pipedrive and Zapier integrations. Grow is USD 40 per user per month with a minimum of ten team members and adds advanced automations, advanced reporting and insights, HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, and full onboarding. Enterprise is quoted and the page states it starts at USD 2,000 per month on annual terms. Annual billing is stated at 10 percent below monthly. All plans include a seven-day free trial, and the page states that WhatsApp messaging fees are paid directly to Meta (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per user per month, billed monthly or annually, with a stated seat minimum on each published tier

consider_for: Teams whose WhatsApp traffic concentrates in repeat conversations with a known contact base, because the meter counts the contacts talked to each month rather than the messages exchanged
pricing_note: Starter is USD 79 a month, or USD 948 a year against a USD 1,188 list, and includes five users, 5,000 AI credits, team and custom inboxes, the mobile app, AI Prompt, AI Assist and basic reports, with extra users at USD 12 a month. Growth is USD 159 a month, or USD 1,908 a year against USD 2,388, and adds broadcasts, workflow automation, AI Agents, advanced reports, Zapier and Make integrations and the developer API, with ten users included and extras at USD 20. Advanced is USD 279 a month, or USD 3,348 a year, and adds multiple workspaces, webhooks, single sign-on and custom channels. Enterprise is quoted (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per month or per year by monthly active contact band, with published per-additional-user rates

consider_for: Organisations running messaging across several locations or brands that need subaccount separation and single sign-on without moving to a negotiated enterprise contract
pricing_note: Five tiers are published on the US plan view. Basics is USD 49 a month with three automations, one user and 1,000 SMS included. Conversations is USD 99 with 30 automations, two users, 3,000 SMS, access controls and shared contacts and inbox. Pro is USD 249 with unlimited automations, three users, 10,000 SMS and one subaccount. Pro Plus is USD 450 with two subaccounts, 20,000 SMS and single sign-on. Advanced is USD 799 with three subaccounts and 40,000 SMS. Annual billing is stated at 16 percent below monthly, a 14-day free trial is offered, and the page carries a country selector that changes the plan view (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Per month or per year against a stated per-plan message allowance and user count, with message rate discounts rising by tier

consider_for: Apparel, accessory and consumer brands whose wholesale selling starts from a linesheet or a seasonal presentation rather than a permanent catalogue, as the plan table documents
pricing_note: Basic at $50 a month billed annually covers a single brand, 25 active products and 50 active SKUs with orders, invoices, Stripe, PayPal and Shopify sync. Startup at $83 a month billed annually raises this to 150 active products and unlimited SKUs and adds external reps, buyer activity tracking, volume discounts and the mobile ordering app. Business and Enterprise are quoted, and add unlimited brands and products, API and ERP file-drop integration, future ship windows and private invite emails (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Published monthly figures are stated as billed annually

consider_for: Brands selling through dealers and retailers where the assortment is built for each account, because the platform documents an assortment builder, custom collections with account-specific pricing and a drag-and-drop merchandising whiteboard
pricing_note: Quote-based: no rate card, entry tier or unit price appears on the Elastic Suite site, which routes enquiries to a demo request. No pricing page is published (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Fashion, accessory and lifestyle brands whose growth depends on reaching new retailers, because JOOR pairs wholesale order management with a searchable retailer directory and digital trade shows
pricing_note: Quote-based. The pricing page presents three plans, Starter for brands under $1 million in annual wholesale revenue, Pro with a dedicated client success manager, and Enterprise for additional capacity, and compares them feature by feature without publishing a figure at any tier. JOOR Pay invoicing and payment processing are listed as carrying a transaction fee, with the rate not stated. Banner advertising, studio photography services and integration work are listed as premium add-ons (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Not recorded; the pricing page states a transaction fee on JOOR Pay without giving a rate

consider_for: Small and mid-sized wholesalers running QuickBooks Desktop or Online whose order entry is manual, as the vendor's pricing page documents the integration as the basis of each module
pricing_note: Three modules with published standalone prices: B2B Customer Portal at $280 a month, Sales Rep Portal on tiered pricing starting at $150 a month, and Shipments Manager at $200 a month. Bundling the customer portal with the rep portal takes $100 a month off, and the same $100 discount is stated against Shipments Manager. Unlimited customers are included on the customer portal, and guided setup with a dedicated account manager plus phone and email support are stated as included (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Stated as per month per module, with a stated $100 per month bundling discount

consider_for: Brands selling into department stores and specialty retail whose buyers plan assortments before ordering, as the platform documents duplicate-buy detection, visual roll-ups and localised size curves on the buying side
pricing_note: Quote-based: no rate card, entry tier or unit price appears on the NuORDER site, which routes enquiries to a demo request. The product is sold under Lightspeed, and pricing is not published at the brand, retailer or marketplace level (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Manufacturers, distributors and multi-brand groups that need several storefronts, complex account hierarchies and a choice of hosting, as the editions page documents a single licence across sites and channels
pricing_note: Two editions. Community Edition is free and downloadable. Enterprise is quoted: the vendor states the licence is aligned to gross merchandise value bands, that 25 internal admin users are included and further admin users are chargeable, and that buyer accounts, storefronts, portals, catalogue size, API calls, sales channels and transactions are not charged for. Hosting cost depends on whether OroCloud, a private cloud or on-premise is chosen. OroPay carries a transaction fee stated as within common industry ranges (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Enterprise licence stated as scaling with GMV bands and internal admin users; hosting priced separately

consider_for: Consumer goods brands and distributors whose reps visit accounts, because Pepperi documents route planning, in-store activity tracking and offline mobile ordering beside the B2B storefront
pricing_note: Quote-based. The pepperi.com/pricing/ URL returns 404 and no rate card, entry tier or unit price appears elsewhere on the site, so the tier structure is not publicly checkable. Enquiries route to a pricing request (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Brands already running a Shopify storefront that want wholesale ordering, buyer-specific price lists and sales agent ordering on the same store, as the SparkLayer pricing page documents
pricing_note: Published plan ladder: Basic free at 5 B2B orders a month, Starter $49 a month at 50 orders, Growth $149 a month at 100 orders, Pro $299 a month, and Enterprise from $499 a month. Every paid plan carries a 14-day free trial. The meter is B2B orders processed through SparkLayer per month, not revenue (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Stated as per month, with a 14-day free trial on every paid plan

consider_for: Brands whose orders arrive through more than one route, because Turis prices and sells the branded portal, the emailed-order reader and the EDI connection as three independent channels
pricing_note: Three published ladders. B2B Storefront runs from EUR 299 a month up to EUR 1,499 a month by monthly order value through the storefront, with above EUR 1 million quoted. Vision, which reads emailed orders, runs from EUR 199 a month for up to 100 orders at EUR 1.99 each down to EUR 0.75 each at 2,000 orders. Turnkey EDI is from EUR 200 a month per retail partner plus a one-off EUR 200 per partner for registration and the chain's test cycle. The vendor states no setup fee, no sales commission, no per-user charge and a 12 month term (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Stated as per month on a 12 month term, with a 14-day trial covering everything except turnkey EDI

consider_for: Wholesale sellers whose reps take orders in person as well as online, because Zoey's plan table documents a storefront and a native mobile app with the higher tiers including both
pricing_note: Published starting figures: Starter from $600 a month and Pro from $2,200 a month, with a Plus tier between them and Enterprise on contact. The pricing page states no revenue-based fees and no payment processing fees on sales orders, and a 6 percent saving for prepaying an annual contract. Plans differ by staff licences, included accounts and whether the storefront, the mobile app or both are included; extra licences are listed at $75 or $50 each depending on tier (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Stated as per month, with a 6 percent saving on annual contract prepayment

consider_for: Large retail, parcel and distribution yards running several shunters and high trailer counts, where the problem is automated task assignment rather than visibility alone
pricing_note: No rate card published; C3 Yard is quoted after a demo or expert consultation, and the vendor publishes a return-on-investment calculator in place of a rate card (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Shippers and 3PLs that want dock scheduling, driver check-in and yard management bought as separate modules on a single login
pricing_note: Quote-based: the vendor publishes no rate card and no pricing page, and describes the commercial model as modular, each module bought as it is needed (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Large shippers already using real-time transportation visibility that want trailer ETAs and network data driving yard prioritisation rather than a standalone yard record
pricing_note: No rate card published; the vendor's help centre documents Dynamic Yard as a paid product arranged through a customer success manager, quoted per deployment (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Mid-size European shippers and manufacturers that want dock scheduling and yard management on one subscription and need a published entry price
pricing_note: Goramp's own site publishes a starting figure of $175 a month with a free trial, states that price scales with docks, facilities and modules, and states that the full yard suite sits at a higher, unpublished tier (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Subscription scaling with docks, facilities and modules; entry figure published as a monthly rate with a free trial

consider_for: North American distribution centres whose carrier base already books through Opendock and that want gate and yard control added to that scheduling platform
pricing_note: No rate card published; the site routes warehouse buyers to a demo request form, and carrier, broker and dispatcher portal access is marketed as free (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: SAP S/4HANA operators running truck, container and rail yards that need yard execution and internal billing inside the existing ERP rather than a third-party system
pricing_note: Price upon request; the published model bills by document per year in blocks of 5,000, counting every check-in and check-out posting per transportation unit, minimum three blocks, contract 3 to 60 months (checked Sep 2026)
billing_terms: Billed by document per year in blocks of 5,000 documents, minimum three blocks; contract duration between 3 and 60 months with auto-renewal and stated prerequisites

consider_for: Operators whose main yard cost is gate labour and check-in time, and who want computer vision applied to one process before committing to a full yard system
pricing_note: No rate card published; the platform is quoted after a demo request, with the vendor stating a buyer can start with a single application at low cost and expand (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: High-volume distribution centres where paperwork is the bottleneck and the yard system must carry electronic bills of lading as well as trailer positions
pricing_note: No rate card published; the platform is quoted after a demo request (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Multi-site operators in cold chain, manufacturing and 3PL that want a purpose-built yard system with short training time and no adjacent transport modules
pricing_note: No rate card published; the product is quoted after a demo request, and the vendor publishes customer-attributed savings figures in place of a price (checked Sep 2026)

consider_for: Logistics teams that want a long-established cloud yard system covering yard, dock scheduling and compliance records without buying a wider supply chain suite
pricing_note: No rate card published; the platform is quoted after a personalised demo request (checked Sep 2026)
